Integration with Java backends and real-time features through STOMP. Use of Cursor, OpenCode, MCP servers and skills to support code writing, review and refactoring.

Worked with Angular, RxJS, PrimeNG and Bootstrap and implemented end-to-end tests with Cypress on key flows, reducing regression risk during releases. Technical mentoring, best practices, code review and alignment with business goals in an Agile context.

Integrated REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js, built real-time features with Socket.IO and managed persistence with MySQL in an Agile context.
